clues.text: This city stands on both banks of a wide river in the north centre of its land, in the east of Europe. It is one of the oldest cities of the east.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player in the east of Europe, on both banks of a wide river.

source.quote: Located in the north-central part of the country, it straddles both banks of the Dnieper River.

clues.text: In winter the wide river here freezes, and folks fish through holes in the ice. In summer they sunbathe on a beach by the same river.
clues.narrowing: Rules out mild lands; keeps a river city with ice in winter and beach days in summer.

source.quote: Ice fishing on the Dnipro river in winter; people sunbathing on a nearby beach during summer.

clues.text: Viking rulers took this city in the mid 800s and made it a capital. It led Rus, the first state of the East Slavs.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals the Vikings made the heart of the first East Slav state.

source.quote: Under Varangian rule, the city became a capital of Kievan Rus', the first East Slavic state.

clues.text: St Sophia Cathedral, raised by Prince Yaroslav the Wise, still stands in this city. It has stood here for about a thousand years.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: Yaroslav's great cathedral still stands in this city.

source.quote: such as the erection of St. Sophia Cathedral by Yaroslav the Wise

clues.text: This city stayed the capital of Ukraine when the land won its freedom in 1991. It is still the nation's biggest and richest city.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: Ukraine's capital since freedom in 1991, still its biggest city.

source.quote: Following the collapse of the Soviet Union and Ukrainian independence in 1991, during the country's transformation into a market economy and electoral democracy, Kyiv has continued to be Ukraine's largest and wealthiest city.

reveal.blurb: Traders settled here on the river long ago, on the road from the Vikings to the Greeks. The city grew as the capital of Rus, and St Sophia Cathedral from those days still stands today. Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine.
